#### Veeam

**Malware Detection**

This dashboard gives visibility into malware detection in the Veeam event data stream. It highlights total events and unique affected objects, trends over time, and Event ID breakdowns. It surfaces infected objects and event outcomes. Use the controls above to filter by Event ID and host. Together, these panels offer a malware-detection view to support security oversight, auditing, and usage analysis.
